newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's Howard says confident in Costello.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's Howard says confident in Costello.

text.p: Australian Prime Minister John Howard said on Tuesday that he still had complete confidence in Treasurer Peter Costello.
"The treasurer has my total confidence," Howard told parliament. "He did a very, very good job on the budget and the treasurer retains my complete confidence."

Opposition politicians last week called for Costello's resignation after he allegedly revealed to the media details of a private conversation with U.S. Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan. The comments on U.S. inflation boosted world financial markets.
Asked if he required Costello to formally apologise to Greenspan, Howard said: "I think the treasurer has dealt with it adequately and I have nothing to add."
It was the first time Howard had commented on the incident since it happened last Tuesday.
Costello has denied that he revealed any confidential information, saying everything he said was previously known to the public.
